recognize_zh: S-100 染色中，大型組織球的細胞核與細胞質呈強陽性，箭頭處細胞內可見多個未染色的淋巴球輪廓（被吞入的細胞呈負影），清楚凸顯 emperipolesis，是 Rosai-Dorfman 病的關鍵免疫染色。
features: IHC for S100 at high power
Large histiocytes with strong nuclear and cytoplasmic S100 staining
Negative-image intracytoplasmic lymphocytes within a large positive histiocyte (emperipolesis, arrow)
Engulfed cells retain intact round nuclei with surrounding halos
Diffuse staining of neighboring histiocytes creates a dense brown background
describe_en: S100 immunostain at high power shows large histiocytes with strong nuclear and cytoplasmic positivity. A large S100-positive histiocyte contains multiple intact, unstained lymphocytes within its cytoplasm, highlighted as negative images (emperipolesis, arrow). Neighboring histiocytes are also strongly positive. Findings confirm the Rosai-Dorfman histiocyte phenotype (S100+, typically CD68+/CD163+, CD1a−) and are consistent with extranodal Rosai-Dorfman disease.

ddx.vs: LCH is also S100 positive but shows grooved nuclei and CD1a/langerin positivity without emperipolesis.
Melanoma is S100 positive but shows cytologic atypia, nucleoli, and SOX10/HMB45/Melan-A positivity, and lacks emperipolesis.
IDCS is S100 positive but forms a spindled-to-ovoid fascicular or whorled neoplasm with atypia, lacking emperipolesis and the plasma cell-rich background.
HLH macrophages are S100 negative and degrade the engulfed cells.
